notes.title: First playtest starts this week
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]First playtest of [i]Drinking Medieval starts at  the end of this week.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]It will have a place until end of next week.[/p][p][/p][p]In this early playtest you can see current state of development - for now I don't have a whole game - just some pieces than later I can make into the game and get all together.[/p][p][/p][p]Please play the game and leave your feedback. Feedback form available in the main menu of the game and some other places.[/p]
